command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
$main="ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"
$candidate="e6ef1286282c423ea59f2affc5c71be55dd0184b"
$branch="work/search-content-regex-20261007"
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
& git fetch origin main $branch --no-tags --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "final content regex fetch failed"}
if((& git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main).Trim() -ne $main){throw "main moved before final content regex validation"}
if((& git rev-parse ("refs/remotes/origin/"+$branch)).Trim() -ne $candidate){throw "final content regex candidate moved"}
$temp=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("fly-content-regex-final-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID)
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Recurse -Force}
try{
  & git worktree add --detach $temp $candidate
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "final content regex worktree add failed"}
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $temp
  & git diff --check ($main+"..."+$candidate)
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "final content regex diff check failed"}
  & python -X utf8 tools\winui\run_checks.py fast --before $main --head $candidate
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "final content regex FAST failed"}
  & .\build.bat Release
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "final content regex Release build failed"}
  & python -X utf8 tools\winui\run_checks.py gui --area search-content-regex --configuration Release
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "final content regex UIA functional failed"}

  $evidence=Join-Path $repo "logs\remote-evidence"
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $evidence | Out-Null
  $owned=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-final-owned"
  $left=Join-Path $owned "Left"
  foreach($p in @($left,(Join-Path $owned "appdata"),(Join-Path $owned "localdata"),(Join-Path $owned "tmp"))){
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $p | Out-Null
  }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $left "readme.txt") -Value "owned final visual fixture" -Encoding UTF8
  $capture=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-final-after.bmp"
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $capture -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $script=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "wait-content-regex-final-xaml.py"
@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c
import ctypes.wintypes as W
import os, subprocess, sys, time
from pywinauto import Desktop

exe=Path(sys.argv[1]); left=Path(sys.argv[2]); owned=Path(sys.argv[3]); capture=Path(sys.argv[4])
env={**os.environ,
     "APPDATA":str(owned/"appdata"),
     "LOCALAPPDATA":str(owned/"localdata"),
     "TEMP":str(owned/"tmp"),"TMP":str(owned/"tmp"),
     "FLY_CONTENT_REGEX_VISUAL_CAPTURE_PATH":str(capture)}
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.EnumWindows.argtypes=[CALL,W.LPARAM]
u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
u.GetWindowTextW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.LPWSTR,c.c_int]
u.PostMessageW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.UINT,W.WPARAM,W.LPARAM]
def ownedwindows(pid):
    found=[]
    @CALL
    def cb(hwnd,_):
        process=W.DWORD();u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd,c.byref(process))
        if process.value==pid and u.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
            title=c.create_unicode_buffer(700);u.GetWindowTextW(hwnd,title,len(title))
            found.append((int(hwnd),title.value))
        return 1
    u.EnumWindows(cb,0);return found
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(left)],cwd=str(exe.parent),env=env,
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
hwnd=None
try:
    deadline=time.time()+25
    while time.time()<deadline:
        if proc.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError(f"final visual app exited: {proc.returncode}")
        windows=[x for x in ownedwindows(proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in x[1]]
        if len(windows)==1: hwnd=windows[0][0];break
        time.sleep(.15)
    if hwnd is None: raise RuntimeError("final visual HWND missing")
    win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd)
    deadline=time.time()+12
    while time.time()<deadline:
        content=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchContentBox")
        regex=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchContentRegexBox")
        encoding=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchContentEncodingBox")
        if (content.exists(timeout=.1) and content.is_visible() and
            regex.exists(timeout=.1) and regex.is_visible() and
            encoding.exists(timeout=.1) and encoding.is_visible() and
            capture.is_file() and capture.stat().st_size>100000):
            break
        time.sleep(.15)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(f"final XAML capture not ready size={capture.stat().st_size if capture.exists() else 0}")
    cr=content.rectangle(); rr=regex.rectangle(); er=encoding.rectangle()
    if cr.right>rr.left or rr.right>er.left:
        raise RuntimeError(f"final content row overlap content={cr} regex={rr} encoding={er}")
    print(f"FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_XAML_CAPTURE={capture}",flush=True)
    print(f"FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_GEOMETRY content={cr} regex={rr} encoding={er}",flush=True)
    print("FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_NON_OVERLAP=PASS",flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if hwnd:u.PostMessageW(W.HWND(hwnd),0x10,0,0)
        try:proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill();proc.wait(timeout=5)
    print(f"FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_VISUAL_PROCESS_EXIT={proc.returncode}",flush=True)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8
  & python -X utf8 $script (Join-Path $temp "out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe") $left $owned $capture
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "final owned XAML visual capture failed"}
  if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $capture -PathType Leaf)){throw "final owned XAML BMP missing"}
  Write-Host "FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_FAST=PASS"
  Write-Host "FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_RELEASE_BUILD=PASS"
  Write-Host "FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_UIA_GUI=PASS"
  Write-Host "FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_XAML_VISUAL=PASS"
  Write-Host "FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_PRIOR_NATIVE_DEBUG=37547158373"
  Write-Host "FINAL_CONTENT_REGEX_PRIOR_NATIVE_RELEASE=37547329626"
}finally{
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
  if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){& git worktree remove --force $temp}
  & git worktree prune
}
